item.text: {"search_note":"The evidence in 2024 is mostly doctrinal and disciplinary rhetoric, not a documented operational upgrade. If you need a stricter scoring call, the main missing piece is a source showing: a new launch authorization rule; a custody or warhead-movement safeguard; a safety drill or accident-prevention protocol specific to nuclear forces; or an independent confirmation that the Rocket Force purge translated into tighter nuclear command control.","evidence":[{"title":"No-first-use of Nuclear Weapons Initiative","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng./xw/wjbxw/202407/t20240723_11458632.html","summary":"Official paper says Xi re-affirmed that nuclear weapons cannot be used and nuclear war must not be fought, and reiterates China’s no-first-use stance. This supports a disciplined, anti-accident nuclear posture, though it is declaratory rather than operational.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Nuclear arms control","publisher":"PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/zzjg_663340/jks_665232/kjfywj_665252/202407/t20240723_11458633.html","summary":"China said nuclear arms control should reduce strategic risk, keep stability, and remain “step-by-step.” This is supportive of controlled, cautious nuclear governance, but again it does not show a new 2024 safeguard mechanism.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Book of Xi's discourses on Party discipline published","publisher":"Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn","date":"2024-05-26","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html","summary":"Xi’s discipline campaign was presented as a push to strengthen discipline awareness and ensure members remain “loyal, clean and responsible.” This is broader Party/military discipline evidence, indirectly relevant to command-and-control reliability.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Xi urges strategic missile troops to enhance deterrence, combat capabilities","publisher":"Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn","date":"2024-10-19","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202410/19/content_WS67136968c6d0868f4e8ec184.html","summary":"Xi inspected a Rocket Force brigade, stressed Party absolute leadership, good command, training, and combat preparedness. That shows attention to command discipline, but the emphasis is on deterrence and combat capability, not explicit custody or safety safeguards.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"China’s Communist Party targets another PLA Rocket Force chief in corruption investigation","publisher":"South China Morning Post / Reuters","date":"2024-07-18","url":"https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact","summary":"Reuters reported that Rocket Force chief of staff Sun Jinming was expelled amid a wider purge of senior Rocket Force officers overseeing China’s nuclear arsenal. That is strong evidence of discipline breakdown inside the force responsible for nuclear missiles.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"China strictly follows nuclear policy of no first use of nuclear weapons: Defense Spokesperson","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html","summary":"After China’s September ICBM launch, the spokesperson said China’s nuclear policy is stable, consistent, predictable, and based on no-first-use and minimum required capability. This is the clearest 2024 reassurance after a live missile event, though still not a concrete safeguard reform.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1","1B.2"]}]}
